{{Quote|Be careful when going after Kazic Pendre. As far as we can tell, all of the employees at his business, Pendretronics, are normal, hard working people with no criminal records.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize|Baize]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />}}
'''Pendretronics''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] engineering company based in [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|You were warned not to harm any of the Pendretronics employees.|Captain Baize, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />}}
Pendretronics was named after its owner, the businessman [[Kazic Pendre]], who was also a member of the criminal organization known as the [[Chirq Council]].<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />

[[File:Pendretronics.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Pendretronics headquarters, in Doaba Guerfel.]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an engineer by the name [[Shobbo Durron]] designed a [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] that was more efficient and potentially cheaper to manufacture than those on the market.<ref name="SWG:TSPCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|The Stolen Power Cell Schematic|Corellia}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Kazic Pendre stole Durron's design notes and her schematic for the benefit of his own company. Kazic Durron later hired a spacer to recover her power cell schematic from Pendre. The spacer thus entered the Pendretronics headquarters and sliced Kazic Pendre's data terminal, successfully recovering the data.<ref name="SWG:TSPCS" />

Around the same time, the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an investigation against the Chirq Council following the increase of [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] traffic on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TCCSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: Seek Council|Corellia}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] led the investigation and discovered that Kazic Pendre was part of the criminal organization. A spacer working for Captain Baize killed Pendre soon after.<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pendretronics appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCCAI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pendretronics was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
